summary: Startup Investments (Holdings) Ltd., a subsidiary, agreed to make a primary investment of about Rs. 5 crores in Bizcrum Infotech Private Limited.
quote: Startup Investments (Holdi ng) Ltd. (‘SIHL’), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company at its meeting of the Board of Directors, held today i.e. October 23, 2026 has agreed to make a primary investment of about Rs. 5 crores in Bizcrum Infotech Private Limited (“Bijnis”).
